description: This file defines a custom guardrail class 'AporiaGuardrail' for integration with AporiaAI, used to process and validate messages in a large language model (LLM) context. It includes methods for message transformation, preparing and making API requests to Aporia, and hooks for moderation tasks within a proxy environment.

classes.name: AporiaGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail implementation for integrating AporiaAI's model moderation and validation, extending 'CustomGuardrail'. It manages API interactions, message transformations, and moderation hooks.

methods.name: List[dict] transform_messages(self, messages: List[dict])
methods.description: Transforms input messages to conform to supported roles for AporiaAI, defaulting unsupported roles to 'other'.

methods.name: dict prepare_aporia_request( self, new_messages: List[dict], response_string: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Prepares the request payload for AporiaAPI, including messages and response string, and sets validation target based on their presence.

methods.name: make_aporia_api_request( self, new_messages: List[dict], response_string: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous API request to Aporia with prepared data, handles the response, and raises an exception if the response indicates a policy block.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Post-call hook that sends moderation data to Aporia after a successful LLM call, if guardrail conditions are met.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Moderation hook invoked during the call process, which processes messages and interacts with Aporia for validation, adding headers as needed.
